title: Continuous-Time LQR from a Single Discrete-Time Off-Policy Batch
abstract: arXiv:2611.29725v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study discounted continuous-time linear--quadratic regulation (LQR) with unknown drift parameters and additive noise, using a single batch of discrete-time off-policy transitions. Discrete-time methods target a policy tied to the training interval, while shortening this interval can make learning from finite data more sensitive to noise. Learning an accurate continuous-time controller therefore requires balancing discretization and finite-sample errors while preserving stability throughout policy improvement. We develop a drift-only policy iteration algorithm, termed PhiBE-PI, using one quadratic state--action critic for policy evaluation and explicit greedy improvement. Reusing the batch makes later policies depend on the data. Exploiting the quadratic structure of LQR, we show that the data enter every policy evaluation only through one policy-independent empirical matrix, so a single high-probability bound controls all iterates.

translated_title: 从单批离散时间离策略数据中求解连续时间LQR
translated_abstract: 我们研究带有未知漂移参数和加性噪声的折扣连续时间线性二次调节（LQR）问题，仅使用单批离散时间离策略转移数据。离散时间方法所学习的策略与训练区间绑定，而缩短该区间会使基于有限数据的学习对噪声更加敏感。因此，学习精确的连续时间控制器需要在离散化误差与有限样本误差之间取得平衡，并在策略改进的整个过程中保持稳定性。我们提出了一种仅基于漂移项的策略迭代算法，称为PhiBE-PI，该算法使用单个二次型状态-动作评价器进行策略评估，并采用显式贪心改进。由于重复使用该批次数据，后续策略将依赖于数据。利用LQR的二次结构，我们证明了数据仅通过一个与策略无关的经验矩阵进入每次策略评估，因此单个高概率界即可控制所有迭代过程。
tldr: 该论文提出仅需单批离散时间离策略数据即可学习连续时间LQR的策略迭代算法PhiBE-PI，并利用LQR的二次结构证明数据只通过一个与策略无关的经验矩阵影响所有策略评估，从而用单个高概率界统一控制全部迭代。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PhiBE-PI, a policy iteration algorithm for continuous-time LQR using a single discrete-time off-policy batch, showing that LQR's quadratic structure makes the data enter every policy evaluation through one policy-independent empirical matrix, so a single high-probability bound controls all iterates.
